title: Commit Your Work to the Lord

questions.question: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:1 (ESV): "but the answer of the tongue is from the Lord."

questions.question: Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:3 (ESV): "Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established."

questions.question: Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:18 (ESV): "Pride goes before destruction, and a haughty spirit before a fall."

questions.question: Pleasant words are like a honeycomb, sweetness to the soul and health to the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:24 (ESV): "sweetness to the soul and health to the body."

questions.question: Gray hair is a crown of glory; it is gained in a righteous what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:31 (ESV): "it is gained in a righteous life."

questions.question: The Lord has made everything for its purpose, even the wicked for the day of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:4 (ESV): "even the wicked for the day of trouble."

questions.question: By steadfast love and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the Lord one turns away from what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:6 (ESV): "and by the fear of the Lord one turns away from evil."

questions.question: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues with what?
The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:9 (ESV): "but the Lord establishes his steps."

questions.question: Whoever gives thought to the word will discover good, and blessed is he who trusts in whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:20 (ESV): "and blessed is he who trusts in the Lord."

questions.question: A just balance and scales are the Lord's; all the weights in the bag are his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:11 (ESV): "all the weights in the bag are his work."

questions.question: Kings take pleasure in righteous lips, and they love him who speaks what is what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:13 (ESV): "and they love him who speaks what is right."

questions.question: How much better to get wisdom than gold! To get understanding is to be chosen rather than what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:16 (ESV): "To get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver."

questions.question: A worthless man plots evil, and his speech is like a scorching what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:27 (ESV): "and his speech is like a scorching fire."

questions.question: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from whom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 16:33 (ESV): "but its every decision is from the Lord."

key_verse_text: Commit your work to the Lord, and your plans will be established.
